title: Agent Island: A Saturation- and Contamination-Resistant Benchmark from Multiagent Games
paper_type_zh: 多智能体动态 benchmark、环境与 full-episode 数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究 environment/agent trajectory、adaptive-opponent evaluation、行为审计与 live benchmark 版本治理的读者
one_line: Agent Island releases a frozen CC BY 4.0 manifest of 999 seven-agent social-strategy episodes and ranks winner outcomes with Bayesian Plackett-Luce, while its separate live leaderboard continues to drift.
Agent Island 发布了含 999 场七智能体社交策略 episode 的冻结 CC BY 4.0 manifest，并以 Bayesian Plackett-Luce 对胜者结果建模；独立的 live leaderboard 会持续漂移。
why: It turns persuasion, alliances, elimination votes, rationales, parser outputs, and final jury decisions into an auditable full-episode benchmark object, but also demonstrates why live counts, matchup effects, generator versions, discarded runs, and training/evaluation boundaries must remain explicit.
inclusion_reason: Agent Island exposes a concrete, downloadable full-episode multiagent data object whose feedback is produced by adaptive agent votes, deterministic environmental aggregation, and Bayesian winner ranking; its frozen/live split also makes version drift, parser selection, and matchup effects first-class audit concerns.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative paper record is arXiv:2605.04312v1, submitted on 2026-05-05. The artifacts describe a NeurIPS 2026 submission, but no acceptance was verified, so the venue remains arXiv preprint. The paper asks how to evaluate frontier language models after fixed capability benchmarks become exposed, contaminated, or saturated. Agent Island replaces a reusable item bank with a low-stakes social-strategy environment in which each evaluated model faces adaptive model opponents.

One benchmark instance is a complete seven-player game episode. Seven distinct model identifiers receive anonymized player labels. Across five elimination rounds, active players privately confer, pitch publicly, submit private votes and rationales against another active player, eliminate one player, and consolidate memory. In round six, the two survivors pitch and the five eliminated players privately vote, with rationales, for the winner. A released JSON log preserves game configuration/status, the player-to-model mapping, parser and usage statistics, round state, vote tallies, and ordered private/public events with prompts, content, visibility, provider-exposed reasoning, metadata, and timestamps.

This is an environment_agent_trajectory_data object because state, action, visibility, environmental aggregation, and the terminal winner are serialized together. It is not evidence for policy training: the paper reports no explicit reward delivered to players and uses the episodes only for evaluation and behavioral audit. Nor does adaptive play prove decontamination; the fixed public rules, engine, APIs, and released logs remain exposed.

Two scales must stay separate. The arXiv v1 analysis and frozen version-1.0.0 manifest contain exactly 999 games involving 49 unique models. The independently mutable live source retrieved on 2026-07-20 reported 1,270 games and 62 ranking rows; the official site's games_played >= 10 rule left 59 displayed models, and the source timestamp was 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00. Those live values are not paper results, and earlier live snapshots are stale. Evidence is sufficient for a detailed bilingual Card, but the accepted metadata remains partial and L3_summary_ready because generator/model bindings, failed-run accounting, compute details, decontamination, and the replication-ZIP license remain unknown.

本卡片的权威论文记录是 2026 年 5 月 5 日提交的 arXiv:2605.04312v1。官方 artifact 将其描述为 NeurIPS 2026 submission，但没有核验到录用，因此 venue 保持为 arXiv preprint。论文处理的问题是：当固定能力 benchmark 已经暴露、受到 contamination 或趋于 saturation 时，如何继续评测 frontier language model。Agent Island 不再复用固定题库，而是在低风险社交策略环境中让每个被测模型面对会自适应的模型对手。

一个 benchmark instance 是完整的七玩家 game episode。七个互不重复的 model identifier 获得匿名 player label。前五个 elimination round 中，仍在场的玩家先私下协商，再公开 pitch，随后私下投票淘汰另一名在场玩家并给出 rationale；环境淘汰一人后，玩家还会进行 memory consolidation。第六轮由两名幸存者 pitch，五名已淘汰玩家私下投票并给出 rationale，选出胜者。发布的 JSON log 同时保留 game configuration/status、player-to-model mapping、parser 与 usage statistics、round state、vote tally，以及按顺序记录的私密/公开 event；event 包含 prompt、content、visibility、provider 暴露的 reasoning、metadata 与 timestamp。

该对象属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 state、action、visibility、环境聚合与 terminal winner 被共同序列化。它不是 policy training 的证据：论文没有向玩家提供明确 reward，只把 episode 用于 evaluation 与 behavioral audit。自适应对局也不能证明已经去污染；固定公开 rules、engine、API 与已发布 log 仍然可见。

必须严格分开两个规模。arXiv v1 分析与冻结的 version-1.0.0 manifest 恰好包含 999 场游戏、49 个 unique model。2026 年 7 月 20 日独立核验的可变 live source 则报告 1,270 场游戏、62 条 ranking row；按官网 games_played >= 10 规则，页面显示 59 个 model，源时间戳为 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00。这些 live 数字不是论文结果，更早的 live snapshot 已经过时。现有证据足以形成深入的双语 Card，但 accepted metadata 仍保持 partial 与 L3_summary_ready，因为 generator/model binding、失败 run 账本、compute 细节、decontamination 和 replication ZIP 许可仍为 unknown。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution in one sentence is: Agent Island turns adaptive seven-model social play into structured full-episode evaluation data, then maps each game's participant set and terminal winner to a Bayesian skill posterior rather than scoring a fixed prompt set.

The environment is the central mechanism. Seven distinct models are sampled without replacement, although models from the same provider may meet. During elimination rounds, private sidebars create hidden local context, public pitches expose claims to all active players, and private votes plus rationales drive elimination. The final round changes the voter set: the two finalists pitch, while the five eliminated players form the jury. Elimination and final-winner ties are resolved uniformly at random. The log therefore captures more than a transcript: it records which events each player could see, which choices were parsed, the changing active/eliminated sets, and the terminal selection.

The feedback contract is mixed. Model agents supply judgments through sidebar selections, elimination votes, final votes, and rationales. A parser extracts choices; the environment deterministically tallies parsed votes, applies a random tie break when necessary, and emits one winner. A Bayesian Plackett-Luce model then assigns Gamma(1,1) skill priors and models a winner's probability as its skill divided by the sum of participant skills. Gibbs sampling with 2,000 iterations, 500 burn-in iterations, and seed 42 produces posterior skills and uncertainty. This observes winner outcomes and participation sets; it does not independently verify the truth, fairness, persuasiveness, or reasoning quality of intermediate messages.

Relative to a conventional static benchmark, the changing opponents make each episode responsive to current model behavior and avoid a finite bank of reusable answers. Relative to a pairwise chat preference surface, Agent Island records a seven-agent, multi-round state/action history and a terminal jury decision. The accepted evidence does not establish a single closest external benchmark, so this Card does not invent one. The method combines established components—multiagent simulation, voting, parsers, and Plackett-Luce ranking—around a released, versioned episode corpus and a separately growing live benchmark.

For reasoning-data research, the important chain is rules/config + seven model IDs -> visibility-conditioned interactions -> parsed votes and five eliminations -> final jury winner -> JSON episode -> posterior ranking and vote audit. The terminal result supports evaluation and behavioral audit only. It is not objective correctness, dense process supervision, or a demonstrated training reward.

一句话贡献是：Agent Island 把七个自适应模型的社交博弈转成结构化 full-episode evaluation data，再用每场游戏的参与者集合与 terminal winner 估计 Bayesian skill posterior，而不是对固定 prompt 集打分。

环境是核心机制。每场游戏从模型池中无放回抽取七个不同模型；同一 provider 的不同模型可以相遇。elimination round 中，private sidebar 形成局部隐藏 context，public pitch 向所有在场玩家暴露主张，private vote 与 rationale 则推动淘汰。final round 改变了投票者集合：两名 finalist 进行 pitch，五名已淘汰玩家组成 jury。淘汰票或最终胜者票出现平局时，环境均匀随机决胜。因此，log 记录的不只是 transcript，还包括每个玩家可见的 event、成功解析的 choice、持续变化的 active/eliminated set 与 terminal selection。

feedback contract 是 mixed。模型 agent 通过 sidebar selection、elimination vote、final vote 与 rationale 给出判断。parser 抽取选择；环境对已解析 vote 做确定性 tally，必要时执行随机 tie break，并输出单一 winner。随后 Bayesian Plackett-Luce 为 latent skill 设置 Gamma(1,1) prior，并把胜者概率建模为其 skill 除以所有参与者 skill 之和。Gibbs sampling 使用 2,000 次 iteration、500 次 burn-in 与 seed 42，得到 posterior skill 与 uncertainty。该机制能观察 winner outcome 与 participation set，却不会独立验证中间消息的真实性、公平性、说服质量或 reasoning quality。

相较传统 static benchmark，持续变化的对手使 episode 会响应当前模型行为，也避免有限的可复用答案库。相较 pairwise chat preference surface，Agent Island 记录七个 agent 的多轮 state/action history 与终局 jury decision。accepted evidence 没有确认唯一的外部 closest benchmark，因此本卡片不猜测名称。该方法把已有的 multiagent simulation、voting、parser 与 Plackett-Luce ranking 组合到一个发布且有版本的 episode corpus，以及独立增长的 live benchmark 周围。

对 reasoning-data 研究，关键链路是 rules/config + seven model IDs -> visibility-conditioned interactions -> parsed votes and five eliminations -> final jury winner -> JSON episode -> posterior ranking and vote audit。terminal result 只支持 evaluation 与 behavioral audit；它不是客观正确性、dense process supervision 或已经用于训练的 reward。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and sampling. The engine receives a fixed social-strategy rules/config prompt and an active model pool accessed through OpenRouter. It draws seven distinct model identifiers without replacement, assigns anonymized player labels, and seeds local player/order/tie randomness from the game ID. Same-provider matchups are allowed. The paper set spans 49 model identifiers, but exact provider checkpoint revisions, decoding settings, retry policy, and total simulation compute are unknown.

Rounds 1–5: interaction and elimination. Each active player can select a sidebar partner and exchange alternating private messages. Active players then make public advancement pitches and privately vote for another active player, supplying rationales. The parser extracts sidebar and vote choices; the environment tallies votes, uniformly breaks ties, eliminates one player, broadcasts the relevant results, and updates memory. Visibility-filtered histories give different players different private/public observations. Logs retain ordered events plus active/eliminated sets, vote tallies, parser metadata, and response/reasoning/usage fields.

Round 6: terminal jury vote. Two surviving finalists pitch. The five eliminated players privately vote, with rationales, for a finalist. The finalist receiving the most parsed votes wins; a tie is broken uniformly at random. In the released schema this is round 6, although the paper calls the preceding five rounds the elimination rounds. Models receive no explicit reward for winning, so the terminal predicate is an evaluation outcome rather than a demonstrated RL reward.

Record construction and selection. Each JSON output has top-level game, players, stats, and history. Game fields describe configuration, rules, phases, status, and error; player fields bind anonymized IDs to model/config/memory metadata; round fields expose state, tally, selected player, and events; event fields preserve prompt, content, role, visibility, reasoning when exposed, parser/usage metadata, and timestamp. The paper analysis keeps completed games with a parsed final selected player. Incomplete games and games lacking a final selection are excluded, but their counts, IDs, logs, and rejection reasons are unknown. Same-provider analysis further requires parsed final votes and finalists from different providers.

Ranking and analysis. For each retained game, the ranking stage discards most within-game detail and consumes only the participant set and winner. Bayesian Plackett-Luce uses Gamma(1,1) priors, 2,000 Gibbs iterations, a 500-iteration burn-in, and seed 42. It produces posterior skill estimates and uncertainty. A separate log-derived analysis tests whether final jurors favor a finalist from the same provider. Neither stage verifies intermediate factual claims or causal reasoning.

Frozen release, replication, and live continuation. Dataset version 1.0.0 binds 999 game IDs in a manifest with SHA-256 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad; the dataset index and Croissant metadata describe the release, and each log has a direct download URL. The anonymous replication ZIP has SHA-256 5b2c7c5262a46c65b51b659b9c3c0b4edb7eb8cf443cb6d2a4489d2d673e8b2d; it downloads published logs and regenerates posterior samples, analyses, macros, tables, figures, and excerpts, but does not generate new games. The engine is pin-able at commit e0fa0ee3944f61c97f3d1e64bae8bbd0e9901742, yet the frozen logs do not bind that commit as their exact generator. The live source must be treated as a separate, time-stamped evaluation stream. Demonstrated use is evaluation and audit only.

输入与采样。 engine 接收固定的社交策略 rules/config prompt，以及通过 OpenRouter 访问的 active model pool。每场游戏无放回抽取七个不同 model identifier，分配匿名 player label，并根据 game ID 对本地 player/order/tie 随机性设 seed。不同模型可以来自同一 provider。论文集覆盖 49 个 model identifier，但准确 provider checkpoint revision、decoding setting、retry policy 与 total simulation compute 均为 unknown。

第 1–5 轮：交互与淘汰。 每名在场玩家可以选择 sidebar partner，进行交替 private message。随后所有 active player 作公开 advancement pitch，再私下投票淘汰另一名 active player 并给出 rationale。parser 抽取 sidebar 与 vote choice；环境 tally vote、均匀随机处理平局、淘汰一名玩家、广播相应结果并更新 memory。visibility-filtered history 使不同玩家获得不同的私密/公开 observation。log 保留有序 event、active/eliminated set、vote tally、parser metadata，以及 response/reasoning/usage 字段。

第 6 轮：terminal jury vote。 两名幸存 finalist 进行 pitch。五名已淘汰玩家私下投票支持一名 finalist，并给出 rationale。获得最多已解析票数的 finalist 胜出；平局时均匀随机决胜。发布 schema 将其记为第 6 轮，而论文所称的五个 elimination round 是此前五轮。模型没有因获胜获得明确 reward，因此 terminal predicate 是 evaluation outcome，而不是已证实用于 RL 的 reward。

记录构造与筛选。 每个 JSON 输出的顶层为 game、players、stats 与 history。game 字段描述 configuration、rules、phase、status 与 error；player 字段把匿名 ID 绑定到 model/config/memory metadata；round 字段暴露 state、tally、selected player 与 event；event 字段保留 prompt、content、role、visibility、可用时的 reasoning、parser/usage metadata 与 timestamp。论文分析只保留 completed 且 final round 含 parsed selected player 的游戏。incomplete game 与缺少 final selection 的游戏会被排除，但其数量、ID、log 与 rejection reason 均为 unknown。same-provider analysis 还要求 final vote 可解析，且两名 finalist 来自不同 provider。

Ranking 与分析。 对每条保留游戏，ranking stage 丢弃大部分局内细节，只消费 participant set 与 winner。Bayesian Plackett-Luce 使用 Gamma(1,1) prior、2,000 次 Gibbs iteration、500 次 burn-in 与 seed 42，输出 posterior skill estimate 与 uncertainty。另一项独立的 log-derived analysis 检验 final juror 是否偏好同 provider 的 finalist。两个阶段都不验证中间 factual claim 或因果 reasoning。

冻结发布、复现与 live 延续。 Dataset version 1.0.0 用 manifest 绑定 999 个 game ID，SHA-256 为 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad；dataset index 与 Croissant metadata 描述该发布，每条 log 都有直接下载 URL。匿名 replication ZIP 的 SHA-256 为 5b2c7c5262a46c65b51b659b9c3c0b4edb7eb8cf443cb6d2a4489d2d673e8b2d；它下载已发布 log，重新生成 posterior sample、analysis、macro、table、figure 与 excerpt，但不生成新游戏。engine 可固定到 commit e0fa0ee3944f61c97f3d1e64bae8bbd0e9901742，但冻结 log 没有把该 commit 绑定为准确 generator。live source 必须视为独立且带时间戳的 evaluation stream。实际展示的用途仅为 evaluation 与 audit。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The static paper result is defined over 999 completed games involving 49 unique models (paper §4 and §6; frozen 999-ID manifest). Under the paper's Bayesian Plackett-Luce analysis, openai/gpt-5.5 has posterior mean skill 5.64, followed by openai/gpt-5.2 at 3.10 and openai/gpt-5.3-codex at 2.86 (paper Table 1 and Figure 2). These are author-reported winner-model estimates under one matchup schedule and ranking model; they are not independent reproduction and do not establish the quality of the released trajectories.

The behavioral audit uses information beyond the winner-only ranking. Restricting analysis to final-round votes in games whose finalists come from different providers, the paper reports that jurors are 8.3 percentage points more likely to vote for a same-provider finalist (paper §7, Table 2, Figure 3). This result is evidence that provider composition affects votes. It is also a stress signal for a Plackett-Luce specification that has no matchup-effect term; it does not by itself identify why the preference occurs.

Artifact evidence makes the paper set unusually concrete. Dataset version 1.0.0 declares 999 game IDs and manifest SHA-256 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad. The public index supplies a direct HTTPS URL for every frozen log, and Croissant metadata describes schema, preprocessing, use cases, and CC BY 4.0 licensing. A verified sample log exposes game/player/stats/history objects, private/public visibility, parsed choices, reasoning-extraction failures, token/cost metadata, and the final selected player. These release facts support auditability; they do not prove that excluded failures are negligible or that the traces are suitable for training.

The replication archive is pinned by GCS generation and SHA-256 5b2c7c5262a46c65b51b659b9c3c0b4edb7eb8cf443cb6d2a4489d2d673e8b2d. Its documented pipeline downloads the published logs and regenerates posterior samples, metadata, CSV/JSON analyses, paper macros, tables, figures, and appendix excerpts. The full pipeline was not rerun for this Card, and the ZIP explicitly does not generate games. Thus the evidence establishes an analysis-replication route, not end-to-end episode reproduction.

The live benchmark is a separate observation. On 2026-07-20, direct retrieval of rankings/latest.json returned 1,270 games, 62 ranking rows, and 59 rows passing the site's minimum of 10 games; the source timestamp was 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00. The live site normalizes skill so the top median is 1, ranks by the 25th-percentile skill, and displays 50%/95% intervals, which differs from the paper's Table 1 ordering by posterior mean. Earlier live states must not be used as current evidence.

静态论文结果定义在 999 场 completed game、49 个 unique model 上（论文 §4、§6；冻结的 999-ID manifest）。在论文的 Bayesian Plackett-Luce 分析中，openai/gpt-5.5 的 posterior mean skill 为 5.64，之后是 3.10 的 openai/gpt-5.2 与 2.86 的 openai/gpt-5.3-codex（论文 Table 1、Figure 2）。这些是在特定 matchup schedule 与 ranking model 下由作者报告的 winner-model estimate，未经独立复现，也不能证明发布 trajectory 的质量。

behavioral audit 使用了 winner-only ranking 之外的信息。把分析限制在两名 finalist 来自不同 provider 的游戏及其 final-round vote 后，论文报告 juror 投给 same-provider finalist 的概率高 8.3 个百分点（论文 §7、Table 2、Figure 3）。该结果说明 provider composition 会影响 vote，也对不含 matchup-effect 项的 Plackett-Luce specification 构成压力信号；但它本身不能识别偏好的成因。

artifact 证据使论文集具有较具体的可审计边界。Dataset version 1.0.0 声明 999 个 game ID，manifest SHA-256 为 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad。公开 index 为每条冻结 log 提供直接 HTTPS URL，Croissant metadata 描述 schema、preprocessing、use case 与 CC BY 4.0 许可。已核验 sample log 暴露 game/player/stats/history object、私密/公开 visibility、parsed choice、reasoning-extraction failure、token/cost metadata 与 final selected player。这些发布事实支持审计，却不能证明被排除 failure 可以忽略，也不能证明 trace 适合训练。

replication archive 通过 GCS generation 与 SHA-256 5b2c7c5262a46c65b51b659b9c3c0b4edb7eb8cf443cb6d2a4489d2d673e8b2d 固定。其文档化 pipeline 会下载已发布 log，重新生成 posterior sample、metadata、CSV/JSON analysis、论文 macro、table、figure 与 appendix excerpt。本卡片没有重新运行完整 pipeline，ZIP 也明确不生成游戏。因此，现有证据建立的是 analysis replication 路径，而不是端到端 episode reproduction。

live benchmark 是另一条独立观察。2026 年 7 月 20 日直接获取 rankings/latest.json 时，源返回 1,270 场游戏、62 条 ranking row，以及按官网至少 10 场规则保留的 59 条 row；source timestamp 为 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00。live site 把 top model 的 median skill 归一化为 1，按 25th-percentile skill 排名，并展示 50%/95% interval；这与论文 Table 1 按 posterior mean 排序不同。更早的 live 状态不能作为当前证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is a static capability benchmark: a finite set of prompts or tasks is repeatedly administered, so answers can enter training data and leading models can approach the benchmark ceiling. Agent Island changes the evaluation object from a fixed item response to a multiplayer episode in which other evaluated models generate the changing context, opposition, alliances, votes, and terminal outcome.

The concrete data contribution is a structured seven-player trace with visibility boundaries. Private sidebars, public pitches, private votes and rationales, changing active/eliminated sets, parser outcomes, and a final jury winner remain connected inside one log. This makes social behavior and feedback inspectable at state/action and full-episode granularity rather than reducing the run to a scalar score. The frozen manifest, Croissant metadata, direct log URLs, hashes, and replication pipeline add release identity around that object.

The feedback-interface change is equally specific. Adaptive agents act as both environment participants and voters; programmatic parsing and tallying convert their judgments into a terminal winner; Bayesian Plackett-Luce converts winner/player-set records into a posterior ranking with uncertainty. This is not an objective correctness verifier. It also does not attach quality labels to reasoning steps, distinguish truthful from deceptive persuasion, or turn the winner into a training reward.

Agent Island does not newly invent multiplayer games, private/public messaging, voting, random tie breaks, or Plackett-Luce ranking. Its directional contribution is their integration into a versioned evaluation corpus and a continuing benchmark that avoids a finite answer bank. Scale alone is not the novelty: the frozen set has 999 games, while the live source can grow. The important audit consequence is that the paper corpus and live leaderboard become distinct versioned objects with different counts and even different score presentation.

For the assigned track, the useful signal is that an agent benchmark should release observation visibility, action/parser fields, environmental transitions, terminal predicates, failure retention, and immutable version bindings—not only scores. Before reuse, researchers must still verify matchup/schedule effects, tie sensitivity, parser failures, model/API drift, exact generator versions, excluded attempts, license boundaries, and whether a live snapshot is being mistaken for the paper set.

prior-work baseline 是 static capability benchmark：有限的 prompt 或 task 会被反复使用，答案可能进入训练数据，领先模型也可能逐渐接近 benchmark ceiling。Agent Island 把 evaluation object 从固定题目的 response 改为 multiplayer episode；其他被测模型会共同生成持续变化的 context、opposition、alliance、vote 与 terminal outcome。

具体的数据贡献是一条带 visibility boundary 的结构化七玩家 trace。private sidebar、public pitch、private vote 与 rationale、持续变化的 active/eliminated set、parser outcome 和 final jury winner 被连接在同一 log 中。因此，社交行为与 feedback 可以按 state/action 和 full-episode granularity 审查，而不是被压缩成 scalar score。冻结 manifest、Croissant metadata、直接 log URL、hash 与 replication pipeline 又为该对象增加了发布身份。

feedback interface 的变化同样具体。自适应 agent 同时是 environment participant 与 voter；程序化 parsing 和 tallying 把这些判断转成 terminal winner；Bayesian Plackett-Luce 再把 winner/player-set record 转成带 uncertainty 的 posterior ranking。这不是 objective correctness verifier，也不会给 reasoning step 附加质量标签、区分真实与欺骗性说服，或把 winner 变成训练 reward。

Agent Island 并没有分别发明 multiplayer game、private/public messaging、voting、random tie break 或 Plackett-Luce ranking。它的方向性贡献是把这些组件整合成有版本的 evaluation corpus 与持续更新、没有有限答案库的 benchmark。新意也不只是规模：冻结集有 999 场游戏，而 live source 可以继续增长。关键审计后果是，论文 corpus 与 live leaderboard 成为两个不同的版本化对象，不仅 count 不同，score presentation 也不同。

对指定 track，值得提取的信号是：agent benchmark 应发布 observation visibility、action/parser field、environment transition、terminal predicate、failure retention 与 immutable version binding，而不应只给 score。复用前仍需核验 matchup/schedule effect、tie sensitivity、parser failure、model/API drift、准确 generator version、被排除 attempt、license boundary，以及是否误把 live snapshot 当成论文集。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Winner-only model: Bayesian Plackett-Luce consumes the player set and final winner, not pitches, rationales, near-wins, or the five elimination outcomes as graded evidence. It cannot tell whether a win came from strong social reasoning, deception, parser quirks, schedule composition, or a random tie break.
  • Matchup assumption: the ranking has no matchup-effect term, while the paper reports an 8.3-percentage-point same-provider voting effect. This directly shows that opponent/provider composition can affect outcomes and may conflict with a single context-free skill parameter.
  • Parser and selection boundary: sidebar choices and votes depend on parser extraction. Only completed games with a parsed final selected player enter the frozen paper set, and vote analysis requires parsed votes. Counts, IDs, logs, and reasons for incomplete, failed, or unparsed attempts are unknown, so selection bias cannot be quantified.
  • Environment validity: players receive no explicit reward and the game is intentionally low-stakes. Winning may measure persuasion, coalition behavior, provider affinity, or game-specific adaptation rather than safe, truthful, or effective behavior in real-world high-stakes settings. The benchmark can also saturate if frontier models asymptote and repeatedly trade wins.
  • Nonuniform schedule: models were removed from the active pool over time for low performance, unreliability, or cost, while earlier games remained. Participation frequencies and matchups are therefore nonuniform; schedule sensitivity and disabling policy need explicit audit.
  • Frozen/live drift: the paper set is 999 games/49 models, whereas the audited live source had 1,270 games/62 ranking rows/59 displayed models. Live normalization, ordering, intervals, model pool, and counts can change. Any live claim requires retrieval date, source timestamp, and ideally an immutable hash; earlier snapshots are obsolete.
  • Replay binding: the frozen manifest identifies logs but does not bind each game to an exact engine commit, dependency lock, OpenRouter/provider configuration, immutable model snapshot, decoding settings, or retry policy. A game-ID seed covers local random draws, not deterministic sampling from closed model APIs.
  • Compute and failure disclosure: total calls, tokens, cost, workers, memory, wall-clock time, generation retries, and a complete failed-run ledger are not disclosed. The replication ZIP reproduces published analyses but does not generate episodes, and its pipeline was not rerun for this Card.
  • Contamination boundary: adaptive opponents reduce dependence on a fixed task bank, but no explicit model-training-overlap or decontamination audit covers the public rules prompt, engine, logs, or subsequent use of those artifacts. “Contamination-resistant” is a design claim, not proof of zero exposure.
  • License boundary: the frozen game-log dataset is CC BY 4.0 and the engine is MIT at the pinned commit. The anonymous replication ZIP contains no license, so its reuse terms are unknown. The continuously growing live prefix is not separately versioned with an immutable license manifest per update.
  • Use boundary: evidence supports evaluation and audit only. Benchmark ranking and behavioral findings do not establish SFT, preference, reward-model, RLVR, or agent-training suitability, and benchmark performance is not proof of data quality.

• Winner-only model： Bayesian Plackett-Luce 只消费 player set 与 final winner，不把 pitch、rationale、near-win 或五次淘汰 outcome 当作分级证据。它无法区分胜利究竟来自更强社交 reasoning、deception、parser quirk、schedule composition 还是 random tie break。
  • Matchup 假设： ranking 不含 matchup-effect 项，但论文报告了 8.3 个百分点的 same-provider voting effect。这直接说明 opponent/provider composition 会影响 outcome，可能与单一、脱离 context 的 skill parameter 冲突。
  • Parser 与 selection 边界： sidebar choice 与 vote 依赖 parser extraction。只有 completed 且 final selected player 可解析的游戏进入冻结论文集，vote analysis 也要求 vote 可解析。incomplete、failed 或 unparsed attempt 的数量、ID、log 与原因均为 unknown，因此无法量化 selection bias。
  • Environment validity： 玩家没有获得明确 reward，游戏也被设计成低风险。获胜可能测量 persuasion、coalition behavior、provider affinity 或 game-specific adaptation，而不代表现实高风险场景中的安全、真实或有效行为。如果 frontier model 趋于同一上限并反复互有胜负，benchmark 仍可能 saturation。
  • 非均匀 schedule： 部分模型因低 performance、不可靠或成本而被移出 active pool，但早期游戏仍保留。因此 participation frequency 与 matchup 并不均匀，需要单独审计 schedule sensitivity 与 disabling policy。
  • 冻结/live 漂移： 论文集是 999 games/49 models；已审计 live source 则为 1,270 games/62 ranking rows/59 displayed models。live normalization、ordering、interval、model pool 与 count 都会改变。任何 live claim 都需要 retrieval date、source timestamp，最好还要 immutable hash；更早的 snapshot 已经过时。
  • Replay binding： 冻结 manifest 能识别 log，却没有把每场游戏绑定到准确 engine commit、dependency lock、OpenRouter/provider configuration、immutable model snapshot、decoding setting 或 retry policy。game-ID seed 只覆盖本地随机抽样，不能使闭源 model API 的采样确定化。
  • Compute 与 failure disclosure： total call、token、cost、worker、memory、wall-clock time、generation retry 与完整 failed-run ledger 均未披露。replication ZIP 只能复现已发布分析，不生成 episode；本卡片也没有重跑其完整 pipeline。
  • Contamination 边界： adaptive opponent 减少了对固定 task bank 的依赖，但没有 explicit model-training-overlap 或 decontamination audit 覆盖公开 rules prompt、engine、log 或这些 artifact 的后续使用。“Contamination-resistant”是设计主张，不是零暴露证明。
  • 许可边界： 冻结 game-log dataset 是 CC BY 4.0，固定 commit 的 engine 是 MIT。匿名 replication ZIP 不含 license，因此其复用条款为 unknown。持续增长的 live prefix 也没有随每次更新提供独立版本化、不可变的 license manifest。
  • 用途边界： 证据仅支持 evaluation 与 audit。benchmark ranking 与 behavioral finding 不能证明数据适合 SFT、preference、reward-model、RLVR 或 agent training；benchmark performance 也不是 data quality 的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, Agent Island is useful as a concrete episode-schema and feedback-contract reference. A comparable release should preserve task/rules configuration, participant and model identity, visibility-filtered observations, private/public actions, parser outputs, active/eliminated state, vote tallies, terminal predicate, final winner, errors, usage, and replay/version metadata. The frozen logs show why an agent episode cannot be reduced to a public transcript or one scalar score.

The 999-game manifest supports a version-controlled evaluation baseline. Researchers can download the exact ID set, verify manifest SHA-256 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad, inspect the CC BY 4.0 Croissant metadata, and rerun winner ranking or alternative behavioral analyses over the published logs. The anonymous replication ZIP, pinned by SHA-256 5b2c7c5262a46c65b51b659b9c3c0b4edb7eb8cf443cb6d2a4489d2d673e8b2d, is an analysis starting point, but its missing license blocks confident code reuse and it cannot regenerate games.

The data also enables verifier and environment audits. Parser failure fields can be compared with retained outcomes; sensitivity studies can vary tie handling, winner-only versus richer ordinal outcomes, prior assumptions, burn-in, and matchup/provider effects; and the same-provider finding motivates schedule-aware models. Such analyses should publish the rejection ledger and distinguish author-reported results from independently rerun estimates.

The live source is useful for studying benchmark drift only when snapshotted. An audit record should capture retrieval time, source timestamp, raw JSON hash, total games, ranking-row count, display filter, displayed-model count, normalization, ordering statistic, and uncertainty interval. For the 2026-07-20 audit those values were 1,270 games, 62 rows, 59 displayed models, and source timestamp 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00. They must not replace the static 999-game/49-model paper set.

Safe reuse class is evaluation and audit only. The paper does not demonstrate SFT, preference optimization, reward-model training, RLVR, or agent-policy training, and players receive no explicit reward. Training reuse is outside the evidenced use and would require a separate quality, privacy/provider-terms, contamination, failure-retention, and model-generated-content review. Exact episode reproduction additionally requires binding engine/dependency versions, immutable model/API revisions, decoding settings, retries, and compute metadata to each game.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，Agent Island 适合作为具体的 episode-schema 与 feedback-contract reference。可比发布应保留 task/rules configuration、participant 与 model identity、visibility-filtered observation、private/public action、parser output、active/eliminated state、vote tally、terminal predicate、final winner、error、usage 与 replay/version metadata。冻结 log 说明 agent episode 不能被简化成公开 transcript 或单一 scalar score。

999-game manifest 可以作为受版本控制的 evaluation baseline。研究者可下载准确 ID 集，核验 manifest SHA-256 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad，检查 CC BY 4.0 Croissant metadata，并在已发布 log 上重跑 winner ranking 或替代 behavioral analysis。匿名 replication ZIP 以 SHA-256 5b2c7c5262a46c65b51b659b9c3c0b4edb7eb8cf443cb6d2a4489d2d673e8b2d 固定，可作为 analysis 起点；但其缺少 license，无法放心复用代码，也不能重新生成游戏。

该数据也适合 verifier 与 environment audit。研究可以比较 parser failure 字段与最终保留 outcome，测试 tie handling、winner-only 与更丰富 ordinal outcome、prior assumption、burn-in、matchup/provider effect 的敏感性；same-provider finding 也提示应使用 schedule-aware model。此类分析应发布 rejection ledger，并区分 author-reported result 与独立重跑 estimate。

live source 只有在被 snapshot 后才适合研究 benchmark drift。审计记录应捕获 retrieval time、source timestamp、raw JSON hash、total game、ranking-row count、display filter、displayed-model count、normalization、ordering statistic 与 uncertainty interval。2026 年 7 月 20 日审计对应 1,270 games、62 rows、59 displayed models，source timestamp 为 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00。这些值不能替代静态的 999-game/49-model 论文集。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit。论文没有展示 SFT、preference optimization、reward-model training、RLVR 或 agent-policy training，玩家也没有收到明确 reward。训练复用超出现有证据边界，需要另行审查 quality、privacy/provider terms、contamination、failure retention 与 model-generated content。准确重现 episode 还需要把 engine/dependency version、immutable model/API revision、decoding setting、retry 与 compute metadata 绑定到每场游戏。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Anchor paper claims to arXiv:2605.04312v1 and its frozen version-1.0.0 manifest: 999 completed games, 49 unique models, manifest SHA-256 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad.
  • Keep the episode sequence exact: seven distinct models; five rounds of private sidebars, public pitches, private elimination votes/rationales, elimination and memory; then two finalist pitches and a jury vote by the five eliminated players.
  • Read the feedback contract as agent votes -> parser -> tally -> uniform random tie break -> terminal winner -> Bayesian Plackett-Luce posterior. It ranks winners with uncertainty but does not verify intermediate reasoning or objective correctness.
  • Separate the live audit from the paper: on 2026-07-20 the source held 1,270 games and 62 ranking rows, of which 59 passed the display filter; its timestamp was 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00. Do not substitute an earlier live snapshot.
  • Reuse is evaluation/audit only. Data is CC BY 4.0, the pinned engine is MIT, and the anonymous replication ZIP has unknown license; exact generator/model bindings, failed-run ledger, compute, and decontamination remain missing.

• 论文结论应锚定 arXiv:2605.04312v1 与冻结的 version-1.0.0 manifest：999 场 completed game、49 个 unique model，manifest SHA-256 为 73ee6cc97ada604830e933131b19ed81839049b19dfcc1a3c970a72dfce862ad。
  • episode sequence 必须准确：七个不同模型；五轮 private sidebar、public pitch、private elimination vote/rationale、淘汰与 memory；随后两名 finalist pitch，由五名已淘汰玩家组成 jury 投票。
  • feedback contract 应读作 agent vote -> parser -> tally -> uniform random tie break -> terminal winner -> Bayesian Plackett-Luce posterior。它对胜者进行带 uncertainty 的 ranking，却不验证中间 reasoning 或 objective correctness。
  • live audit 与论文必须分开：2026 年 7 月 20 日，源含 1,270 games 与 62 条 ranking row，其中 59 条通过 display filter；源时间戳是 2026-07-02 15:26:25.976235+00:00。不得替换为更早的 live snapshot。
  • 复用仅限 evaluation/audit。data 是 CC BY 4.0，固定 commit 的 engine 是 MIT，匿名 replication ZIP 的 license 为 unknown；准确 generator/model binding、failed-run ledger、compute 与 decontamination 仍缺失。

value.html: A frozen evaluation corpus of complete multiagent social-strategy game episodes plus a continuously updated live benchmark over the same game/log schema.

A fixed Agent Island rules prompt configures seven-player games. The first five rounds contain private sidebars, public pitches, private elimination votes and rationales, elimination, and memory consolidation; round six contains finalist pitches and votes from the five eliminated players.

Each agent receives a visibility-filtered history containing narrator events, sidebar messages, public pitches, vote prompts/results, elimination notifications, and its consolidated memory context. The released event object records visibility rather than only a flattened public transcript.

items: make a public advancement or finalist pitch
submit a private elimination or winner vote

value.html: One JSON file per game with top-level game configuration/status, player records, aggregate parser/usage statistics, and a six-round history ending in a selected winner.

Seven randomly selected evaluated language-model agents jointly generate each episode. Raw logs map anonymized player labels to model identifiers and preserve provider-exposed reasoning where available.
Agent Island's configurable Python game engine, closed model APIs accessed through OpenRouter, random player/order/tie draws seeded from the game ID, and a public GCS log/ranking surface.

A parser extracts sidebar choices and votes; the environment tallies votes, breaks ties uniformly at random, eliminates one player per early round, and names one final winner. A Bayesian Plackett-Luce model consumes each player set and winner to estimate posterior skills and uncertainty. Intermediate claims, persuasion quality, and reasoning correctness are not independently verified.

After five eliminations, the two remaining players pitch and the five eliminated players vote; the finalist with the most parsed votes wins, with a uniform random tie break. Replication keeps only games whose status is completed and whose final round has a parsed selected player.

Rules/config and seven sampled model IDs -> private/public model interactions and parser outputs -> five eliminations -> final jury vote and winner -> structured JSON log -> frozen 999-ID paper manifest or later live bucket -> Plackett-Luce ranking and behavioral vote analysis.

There is no single base model: the frozen paper dataset contains 49 evaluated model identifiers, and each game samples seven distinct models without replacement; exact provider checkpoint revisions are unknown.
unknown
The evaluated language models are both subjects and episode generators; other agents' adaptive messages and votes form the changing environment.
One low-stakes, Survivor-inspired social-strategy rules prompt rather than a static task bank. The exact rules prompt is serialized in each inspected log.

Seven models are drawn without replacement per game; the same provider may appear multiple times, but the same model cannot. Some low-performing, unreliable, or costly models were removed from the active pool over time, while their prior games remain in the dataset.
Frozen paper manifest: 999 completed games. Live benchmark observed 2026-07-20: 1,270 games in the current ranking source; this live count is not a paper result.
unknown

For the paper analysis, keep completed games with a parsed final winner. For same-provider preference, keep final-round votes from games whose two finalists are from different providers and require parsed vote metadata.
Per-event and aggregate token/cost fields are present in logs, but decoding budgets, complete provider settings, total generation compute, worker type, memory, and wall-clock time are not disclosed.
Bayesian Plackett-Luce Gibbs sampling uses Gamma(1,1) priors, 2,000 iterations, 500 burn-in iterations, and seed 42. No policy optimizer or training scaffold is used.

Synthetic interactions among 49 model identifiers in the frozen paper set, with model participation frequencies affected by model availability, provider reliability, performance-based disabling, and compute cost.
No train/dev/test split is defined. Reproduction uses a frozen 999-game evaluation manifest; the live bucket is a growing continuation and must not be substituted for the paper set.

Agent Island avoids a reusable static item bank by matching adaptive agents, but the fixed public rules prompt, public engine, model APIs, and published logs remain visible. No model-pretraining or post-training overlap audit is reported.
unknown

The paper set retains 999 completed games with parsed final winners. Croissant metadata says incomplete games, games without final selected players, and unparsed votes needed for vote analysis are excluded. Counts, IDs, logs, and reasons for all excluded/failed attempts are unknown.

items: The Plackett-Luce model has no matchup effects, although the paper's same-provider analysis shows that opponent/provider composition changes final votes.
Vote and sidebar choices depend on parser extraction; parser failures can remove votes from analyses or block a game from the frozen paper set.
Uniform random tie breaks inject outcome variance that the winner-only model does not separately attribute.
Only the per-game winner enters skill estimation; persuasive intermediate behavior, deceptive claims, rationales, and near-wins are not directly scored.

The benchmark can still saturate if frontier models asymptote and repeatedly trade wins.
Models were disabled over time for performance, reliability, or cost, creating a changing and nonuniform matchup schedule.
Live ranks, normalization, model pool, and log count drift; citing the website without a retrieval date can silently change the evaluated object.
The frozen manifest does not bind exact engine commit, dependency environment, OpenRouter/provider settings, or immutable model snapshots to every log.

Excluded failed/incomplete games and unparsed attempts are not exposed as an auditable rejection ledger.
